"The AI automatically identifies the scene and suggests optimized adjustments in the mini preview on the bottom right. If you tap on this mini preview the following settings will be adjusted automatically to suit the scene: Look, Exposure, White balance, Saturation, Contrast, Bokeh *This function is only available in Photo mode. *When you start recording a video by pressing and holding the shutter button, saturation, contrast, and bokeh settings will not be applied."

Recommended adjustments based on the scene identified by the AI are displayed in the mini preview on the bottom right (top right when held horizontally). You can apply all of these adjustments at once by tapping the mini preview.
Depending on the scene, a specific lens setting may also be suggested. In this case, you can change to the suggested lens setting depending on your preference.

"By swiping left on the mini preview in the bottom right (top right when held horizontally), you can display alternative adjustment recommendations. The suggestion you select will be saved as your preferred adjustment and will be included in the suggestions next time you shoot in a similar scene."

You can tap the [>] button to hide suggestions when not needed. When a new scene is identified, the [<] button will light up to show you that there are new adjustment suggestions. To check the suggestions again, tap the [<] button.

If you tap the adjustment button after selecting suggested adjustments, you can further adjust settings such as brightness and color. Your adjustments will be saved to the device and applied to the suggested adjustments next time a similar scene is detected.

Suggested adjustments and adjustments made by you can be registered, allowing you to load them at any time to take photos with the same settings. Tap [Register] to add a Custom look to the list of available looks.

"You can choose the finish of images (photos or movies) by selecting a \"look\".
Creative look offers 6 preset looks. Each one is optimized with a different combination of color tone, saturation, contrast, sharpness, brightness, and other image elements, so you can set up image processing with your ideal balance of these elements."
This look tones down some colors while enhancing the sky, greenery, and contrast. A good choice for natural landscapes showing the sea, sky, or mountains, or for other subjects against a blue sky.
Reduces contrast and saturation for a matte look. Recommended for creating an elegant atmosphere or stately images.
The saturation and sharpness are lowered for shooting images in subdued tones. This is also suitable for capturing images that you intend to modify later.
Produces a bright atmosphere with transparency, softness, and vibrancy. Recommended for creating a soft, gentle mood.

This is the standard look for images. The settings, such as color tones, color depth (saturation) and contrast are adjusted to suit a wide range of subjects and scenes. This is useful when shooting snapshots of various subjects quickly and casually.
The saturation and contrast are increased for shooting striking images of colorful scenes and subjects such as flowers, greenery, blue skies, or ocean views.
The Drive mode can be changed to use Single or Continuous shooting, or the self-timer.
"The Drive mode can be changed to use Single or Continuous shooting, or the self-timer. Note: HDR continuous shooting may impact the performance of autofocus or Touch tracking."

"When using the ultra-wide lens (0.7x), you can select a priority. By selecting Prioritize image quality, you can capture dynamic high-quality images. If you select Prioritize correction for distortion, you can reduce visual distortion. This function is active when taking photos using the ultra-wide lens. After switching to the ultra-wide lens, you can configure the priority from MENU > Ultra-wide lens correction."

By creating a bright and cool color finish, you can achieve a transparent expression. Recommended when you want to capture a clear skin tone or when you want to express the transparency of the sky or sea.
Reduces the contrast slightly and casts a slightly pink tone over the entire image. Recommended for evoking a dreamy atmosphere or emphasizing the pink tones of sunsets.
Brightens dark areas to capture images with a lighter impression. Recommended for situations where you want to capture a bright and well-lit face.
Reduces the contrast and saturation to create an ephemeral atmosphere. Recommended when you want to make pigments appear lighter.
Tag your photos and videos with the locations where they were taken. You can change this setting later from MENU > Save location.
This setting achieves cinematic gradations and color expressions, allowing you to shoot with softer color reproduction ideal for shooting portraits.

"Select the file format for still images.
